title: Real Numbers
subtitle: The logic behind numbers
description: Explore prime factorisation, the fundamental theorem of arithmetic, and the properties that make the number system work.
formula: HCF × LCM = Product of two numbers

title: Polynomials
subtitle: Patterns, roots and relationships
description: Understand zeroes of polynomials and the relationship between their zeroes and coefficients.

title: Pair of Linear Equations
subtitle: Two variables, many ways
description: Explore graphical and algebraic methods for solving a pair of linear equations in two variables.

title: Quadratic Equations
subtitle: Where curves meet solutions
description: Learn factorisation, completing the square, the quadratic formula, and the nature of roots.

title: Arithmetic Progressions
subtitle: Discover the rhythm in a sequence
description: Find the common difference, the nth term, and the sum of terms in an arithmetic progression.

title: Triangles
subtitle: Similarity, ratios and proofs
description: Build intuition for similar triangles and use theorems to solve geometric problems.

title: Coordinate Geometry
subtitle: Geometry on a grid
description: Use distance and section formulae to describe geometric relationships on the Cartesian plane.

title: Introduction to Trigonometry
subtitle: Meet the language of angles
description: Understand trigonometric ratios, standard values, and identities through right-angled triangles.

title: Applications of Trigonometry
subtitle: Measure what you cannot reach
description: Apply trigonometric ratios to practical situations involving heights and distances.

title: Circles
subtitle: Tangents and their properties
description: Discover tangent properties and the relationship between a tangent and the radius at the point of contact.

title: Areas Related to Circles
subtitle: Sectors, arcs and segments
description: Calculate areas and lengths involving circles, sectors, and combinations of plane figures.

title: Surface Areas & Volumes
subtitle: Think in three dimensions
description: Work with combinations of solids and understand how dimensions affect surface area and volume.
formula: Volume and surface area of solids

title: Statistics
subtitle: Find the story inside data
description: Organise grouped data and explore mean, median, and mode using the appropriate methods.

title: Probability
subtitle: Measure the chance of an event
description: Understand experimental and theoretical probability and describe the likelihood of simple events.
